title: 上方保护板壁转向
description: 孔版印刷展现板壁路线的小幅转向，完整保护系统与双人姿态清楚。

art_direction.medium: crisp digital comic ink and quiet halftone shadows
art_direction.scene: An original risograph illustration depicts a fictional fully clothed adult making a modest lateral turn on a gentle indoor slab under top-rope protection. Both shoes press positive footholds while broad purple handholds support a short reach. A wide composition includes the correctly fitted climbing harness with proper tie-in through designated points, continuous rope rising to the overhead anchor, and descending rope to a competent harnessed adult belayer. The belayer watches the climber and keeps the brake hand down on the brake strand beside the device. Layer lilac, cobalt, and peach print textures; show clear floor and credible adult anatomy. No free solo, tangled rope, words, or brands.
